title: Urban Agroecoloy: 6,000 lbs of food on 1/10th acre - Urban Homestead - Urban Permaculture
summary: A short film about the Dervaes family, who grow over 6,000 pounds of food a year on a tenth of an acre near downtown Los Angeles. They grow more than 400 plant species, keep chickens and ducks, and get most of their food from the plot.
why: HN cites it as proof of how much food a very small urban plot can produce.

quote.text: You can grow a surprising amount on even 0.1 acres.
